content:
**Highland Marsh** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia. 

The area is a stretch of wetlands south of the Southhampton Estate. It is a fast travel marker and has a variety of Mirelurks roaming around the area. In addition, a Mirelurk Queen will always be found in the shallow water.

Highland Marsh appears in *Fallout 76*.
